visible_text: 導入時期は10月で行きます

observation.happening: Google Meet transcript displayed with hierarchical sections (決まったこと/やること/質問/感想) organizing meeting notes. Right panel shows original Japanese transcript with speaker attribution and timestamps.
observation.most_important: Clear categorization of decisions/actions/questions with speaker names and timestamps; dual-pane layout balances summary view and source transcript
observation.next_action: User can expand sections, mark items as complete, or navigate through meeting timeline
anomalies: Left panel has substantial empty whitespace in lower half despite only 4 sections shown
Inconsistent vertical space allocation for sections with one item vs. multiple items
Section headers maintain visual weight even when 'まだありません'

ai_look: generic blue link styling repeated throughout
centered empty space with no visual treatment
B30D.why: Solid hierarchical organization of meeting content with useful dual-pane layout. However, significant whitespace, generic styling, and uneven density distribution make it feel like a functional prototype rather than refined product. The organizational logic is sound but the visual execution is generic.

visible_text: このメッセージを送ります？
朝日の会議、資料を先に共有します。10月の導入時期の件も入れておきました。

observation.happening: Modal confirmation dialog for sending message to #sales channel, showing full message preview and destination with external visibility warning
observation.most_important: Crystal-clear destination indication and message preview; '外部に出ます' warning signals external visibility risk
observation.next_action: Confirm send or cancel action via bottom buttons
anomalies: Dark theme creates subtle contrast issues between text and background in places
Warning indicator could be more visually prominent given its importance

BFEC.why: Functional and clear confirmation dialog with good information hierarchy and state clarity. The design is safe and appropriate but lacks distinctive personality or visual refinement. Standard modal pattern executed competently but without polish.

observation.happening: Horizontal playback control bar in paused state showing elapsed time with integrated memo, captions, and AI assistant features
observation.most_important: Minimal, focused control surface with clear pause state and time indicator; thoughtful integration of secondary features (Ask Astra) alongside core playback controls
observation.next_action: User can play, add memo, enable captions, or invoke AI assistant

C25A.why: Exemplary control bar design demonstrating masterful hierarchy, density, and geometry. Every element serves clear purpose with precise proportioning. State is unmistakable, spacing is perfect, and visual rhythm is refined. The integration of AI features among playback controls is innovative. Zero visual clutter or wasted pixels.

visible_text: OAuthだけ確認お願いします。

observation.happening: Meeting transcript with OAuth discussion; left panel shows empty sections (決まったこと/やること marked as 'まだありません'), right panel displays transcript timeline with speaker and timestamps
observation.most_important: Clean transcript with speaker attribution; empty-state sections labeled 'まだありません'
observation.next_action: User awaits meeting content to populate sections or navigates transcript
anomalies: Majority of both left and right panels is empty whitespace
Empty sections ('決まったこと', 'やること') consume vertical space with 'まだありません' placeholders
Layout feels like unfilled template rather than intentional empty state
Visual imbalance from symmetrical but sparse content distribution

ai_look: extensive whitespace suggesting unfilled template state
centered empty space creating unfinished feeling
no visual design for empty state — just repeats section headers
C362.why: Excessive whitespace and poor empty-state design create sense of incompleteness rather than calm. The two-column layout becomes a liability when both sides are sparsely populated. Section headers maintain visual weight even when empty, consuming space without providing value. The extensive emptiness increases cognitive load (uncertainty about whether content is missing) rather than providing clarity or calm.

observation.happening: Dark context panel displaying three items AI assistant (Astra) is currently aware of: Notion document, selected user text, and Figma reference. Demonstrates transparent AI context awareness.
observation.most_important: Clear visualization of what information AI 'sees'; builds trust through transparency; useful context surfacing for user awareness
observation.next_action: User can interact with listed context items or close panel
anomalies: Mixed label styling (icon+text vs pure text) creates minor visual unevenness

C424.why: Innovative feature for transparent AI context display with solid panel design. State clarity is exceptional — users understand exactly what AI can access. Geometry and spacing are good, but typography inconsistencies (varying label sizes/weights) prevent perfection. The concept is distinctive and valuable, execution is professional but could be more refined in details.

observation.happening: Dashboard showing greeting, task management (recording with red indicator), upcoming meetings (Google Meet, Zoom), and recent meeting notes being transcribed. Left sidebar enables navigation.
observation.most_important: Integrated task/recording feature with visual indicator; calendar synchronization showing upcoming meetings; active transcription status display
observation.next_action: User can start recording, navigate to meetings, access sidebar sections, or view recent meeting details
anomalies: Calendar item cards have inconsistent visual styling
Transcription status display ('文字起こしを保存しています') uses non-standard format
Red indicator dot could be more contextually prominent

ai_look: familiar dashboard layout without distinctive treatment
C83F.why: Well-organized dashboard with clear information hierarchy and functional feature integration. Calendar, task management, and recording features work intuitively. However, design relies on familiar patterns without distinctive refinement, and visual inconsistencies (varied card styling, non-standard transcription status display) prevent excellence. Competent execution of standard UI patterns.
